_comment: Table Talk deck — prompts written for strangers at a coffee meetup, held to stay-awhile/QUESTIONS.md doctrine. Kinds: ice (one person answers), room (the whole table plays), fight (friendly local superlative debate), either (quick this-or-that). Depth: light or warm only — deep water belongs to Stay Awhile, not a first coffee. Ids are tt### and never reused.
